text: Funmi, a clerk who may not see names, taps School.
Students says names hidden; each child shows as an admission number.
Even the parent’s phone number is masked on her screen.
On Mr Ibe’s phone, his role may show names, so they show.
His student page shows the full name and the parent’s phone.
At the end of the year, Mr Ibe taps School, then Classes, terms and fees.
He taps Promotion at the end of 2026/2027. Each class moves up to the next.
Exceptions list students; he taps one to change it.
He chooses Repeat, so Dami stays in Primary 4.
He taps Promote 2026/2027, and confirms. It happens once.
He goes back to Classes and terms.
He taps the new year’s First term, planned, and then Fees.
Its fees are empty. He taps Copy from Third term.
The fees are copied. He closes the sheet and goes back.
He taps Start beside First term, and confirms.
The term starts: every active student is enrolled, and it is Current.
